executive_positioning.executive_summary_draft: Civil engineer with 25+ years in highway and infrastructure construction, progressing from Junior Engineer to Project Manager across NHAI, state PWD, MMRDA and nuclear-power civil works. Experience spans EPC, BOT (Annuity/DBFO) and BOT-toll delivery, supervision consultancy and performance-based maintenance, on projects with stated contract values from INR 6 Cr to INR 350 Cr. Hands-on in site execution, quality assurance, quantity verification, bill certification and MoRTH/IRC compliance, with a Road Safety Audit certification.

Contracts and commercial: Interim payment certificates and bill certification
Structures and works: RCC and RRM retaining walls, box culverts
